Teofipol Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Khmelnytskyi Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Jews were present in Teofipol from the 18th century, numbering 516 in 1765 and peaking at 2,914 (65 percent) in 1897; two Jewish elementary schools operated in the early 20th century. Pogroms in 1917 and 1919 claimed 300 lives, and by 1936, 94 families belonged to a Jewish kolkhoz founded in 1929. A ghetto for Teofipol and neighboring villages was created immediately after the July 1941 occupation; nearly 1,000 Jews were executed in December 1941. This cemetery, likely emerging in the late 19th century, was fenced by the ESJF in 2016.
